media.title: Hôtel George-V, 31 avenue George-V, Paris — photograph, 2021
media.description: Present-day photograph of the Hôtel George-V at 31 avenue George-V, taken on 7 September 2021. The hotel opened in 1928, and its stone façade on the avenue is the building in which the 1934 reception for Jan Kiepura took place. No photograph of the hotel from the 1930s in the public domain or under an open licence has been traced.
media.altText: Colour photograph of a pale stone Paris hotel building with wrought-iron balconies on a street corner, with trees and parked cars in front.
media.publicCaption: The Hôtel George-V, Paris, opened in 1928, photographed in 2021.
media.publicCreditLine: Photograph by Polymagou, 7 September 2021; Wikimedia Commons; CC BY-SA 4.0.
